title: Memory segment representation
statement: For a memory function $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, a starting address $a$, and a list $l$ of integers, say that $l$ is represented in memory at $a$ when every valid index $i$ into $l$ satisfies $\mu(a+i)=l[i]$.
